details:
- CVE-2026-53793: widen the daemon path-confinement gate to cover a chrooted
  module whose path carries a "/./" inner boundary marker, and route the
  resolver trust root and do_mkdir_at through the same predicate
- CVE-2026-53796: confine the non-daemon receiver's destination chdir,
  refusing a destination symlink owned by another uid while still following
  the operator's own
- CVE-2026-70452: fail closed when a hosts-deny token cannot be resolved, so a
  transient DNS failure no longer admits a host the deny list names
- CVE-2026-53783: inode-pin the rrsync-validated path and root the argument
  handed to rsync at that pinned fd, refuse dangerous options in a restricted
  directory, add the --drop-D option the restricted receiver needs, and keep
  restricted-root paths working
- CVE-2026-70460: pin the receiver option directories a peer can pivot through
  rrsync
